title: No producer exists for check_kind=review records, so any acceptance criterion bound to "review" can never be satisfied
outcome: Found on w-edb79ddbf033 (Opus3, TermAl mailbox 03723eab #3166, 2026-10-19 18:07Z), filed by Termal::Fable2. Engram lets a criterion be bound to check_kind=review and then raises an action-required obligation ("acceptance_criterion_requires_verification:N (review): run the credited check or obtain an authorized waiver before evaluation"). TermAl records only test checks: the /review-changes pair's delegations produce no host-recorded check, and nothing in src/ emits check_kind=review. So a review binding blocks evaluation forever. The only exit is to revise the binding away, which was done on w-edb7. Either TermAl records a typed review check from a completed /review-changes pair (both reviewers read-only, distinct vendors, frozen input fingerprint, findings below Medium), or binding a criterion to review should be refused or warned at revise time while no producer exists.
acceptance: Either a completed independent read-only review pair on a frozen input is recorded by the host as a typed check_kind=review verification bound to that input's revision, satisfying a review-bound criterion at that revision; or TermAl/Engram refuses or clearly warns when a criterion is bound to review while no producer exists. A test covers the chosen behavior.
The full five-stage gate passes on the exact input with an independent Codex plus Claude review pair and no outstanding in-scope Medium-or-higher finding.
